text: dsh-split-view 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的分屏插件：它接管主窗口根界面，并在各个面板中运行独立的 DSH 客户端。用户可以横向或纵向拆分窗口、拖动分隔条调整大小、切换或管理各面板会话，并通过标题栏和快捷键聚焦、最大化、刷新或关闭面板。插件还提供可供其他插件调用的 Cordis 分屏服务，并支持自定义快捷键、聚焦颜色和标题栏显示。适合需要同时查看或操作多个 DSH 会话的网页用户；不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-split-view adds resizable panes to the DSH web client, each running an independent session. Split horizontally or vertically, resize panes, and use controls or shortcuts to focus, maximize, reload, and close them. Other plugins can query and manage panes through its Cordis service.
想在一个 DSH 网页里同时看几个会话。
能不能把 DSH 窗口拆成横向或纵向的面板？
我想拖动分隔线调整多个会话窗口的大小。
让 DSH 的每个分屏都打开独立会话。
有没有办法快速聚焦、最大化或关闭当前面板？
I want to work on several DSH sessions side by side in one browser window.
dsh-split-view 的功能「分屏布局」：用户可将聚焦面板向右或向下拆分，并嵌套排列多个面板；拖动分隔条可调整各区域大小。
dsh-split-view 的功能「独立会话」：每个面板通过 iframe 运行完整 DSH 客户端，可在面板中固定已有会话或创建新会话，并查看会话标题。
dsh-split-view 的功能「面板控制」：面板标题栏提供分屏、最大化还原、刷新和关闭等操作；键盘快捷键也可控制聚焦面板。
dsh-split-view 的功能「分屏设置」：设置页可自定义分屏快捷键、聚焦颜色和标题栏显示；偏好保存在浏览器 localStorage。
dsh-split-view 的功能「插件服务 API」：其他 Cordis 插件可调用 dsh-split-view 服务查询面板与布局，并执行分屏、会话操作或订阅状态变化。
希望在同一个网页里对照处理多个 DSH 会话。
想把几个 DSH 会话放在同一窗口里对照处理。

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-split-view)

一个插件把 DeepSeek Harness 主窗口变成多个分屏，同时查看多个会话的状态。

有过【同时跑多个任务】经历的同学应该能感受这种痛苦：多个标签切来切去，很心累。

dsh-split-view 分屏插件借鉴了终端分屏的思想。将 DSH 主窗口变成一个可拖拽的分屏容器，每个分屏里跑一个完整的 DSH 客户端。

dsh-split-view README · 长什么样：上面是日常操作：向右分屏、向下分屏、拖动分割条调整大小、双击标题栏放大、关闭。

横竖任意嵌套。每个面板一条标题栏，左边实时显示当前会话标题，右边是向右分屏、向下分屏、放大还原、刷新、关闭五个按钮。点标题直接改名，双击放大，还能一键复制「会话 id + 会话标题」。

dsh-split-view README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-split-view
dsh web   # 重启生效
```

本地开发从源码装：`dsh plugin --profile web add -w /path/to/dsh-split-view`。

卸载用 `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-split-view`，重启恢复单窗口。插件本身如果出问题，boot 会停下来报错，不会静默白屏，所以卸载也就是紧急恢复的办法。

**兼容范围**：dsh `0.1.0-rc.6` 起至 `0.2.x`，一份构建同时适配两代宿主。dsh 0.2.0 起有 peer 门禁，若装的是 0.2.5 及更早版本，启动日志会出现 `skipping profile bundle "dsh-split-view"`、界面上看不到分屏按钮——升级到 0.2.6 及以上即可。

dsh-split-view README · 默认快捷键（支持在设置中自定义）：| 键（macOS ⌘，Windows/Linux Ctrl） | 动作 |
|---|---|
| ⇧⌘D | 向右分屏 |
| ⇧⌘V | 向下分屏 |
| ⇧⌘X | 关闭聚焦面板 |
| ⇧⌘Enter | 最大化 / 还原聚焦面板 |
section: 默认快捷键（支持在设置中自定义）

text:
dsh-split-view README · 设置：在任意面板里打开设置，左侧导航有一项「分屏」。

四组设置：

- **快捷键**：点某个动作的组合键进入录制，按新组合完成改绑，Esc 取消。绑什么由你决定：被浏览器或系统占用的组合、和别的动作撞车的组合照样能绑，只会给出提示；唯一的硬性要求是得带 ⌘/Ctrl。
- **选中高亮色**：聚焦面板的描边和标题栏染色。预设色板、自定义取色器，外加「跟随主题」——跟随当前皮肤的品牌色 token，换皮肤自动跟着变。
- **标题栏**：一个开关，隐藏所有面板的标题栏。注意标题栏上有复制会话信息、分屏、最大化、刷新、关闭按钮，双击放大、点标题重命名也走标题栏，隐藏后这些动作只能靠快捷键；点面板聚焦不受影响。
- **恢复默认**：一键把上面全部还原，点之前会弹确认。

dsh-split-view README · 供其它插件调用：分屏能力整体暴露成了一个 Cordis 服务：面板操作、面板×会话操作（加载指定会话、发消息、改名、换模型、取消回合）、查询与订阅。面向集成方的服务 API 见 [api.md](./api.md)。

如果你要实现类似于 Claude Code 的 agent teams的插件，可以通过本插件提供的 api 来实现等同于 [agent teams 的 Split-pane 模式](https://code.claude.com/docs/zh-CN/agent-teams#choose-a-display-mode)的分屏显示功能。

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-split-view)

One plugin that turns the DeepSeek Harness main window into split panes, so you can watch several sessions at once.

If you have ever run several tasks at the same time, you know the pain: switching between tabs over and over.

dsh-split-view borrows the idea of terminal splitting. The DSH main window becomes a draggable split container, and each pane runs a full DSH client of its own.

dsh-split-view README · What it looks like：Above is daily use: split right, split down, drag the divider, double-click the title bar to maximize, close.

Horizontal and vertical splits nest freely. Every pane has a title bar: the live session title on the left, and five buttons on the right — split right, split down, maximize/restore, reload, close. Click the title to rename the session, double-click to maximize, and copy "session id + session title" with one click.

dsh-split-view README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-split-view
dsh web   # restart to activate
```

Install from source for local development: `dsh plugin --profile web add -w /path/to/dsh-split-view`.

Uninstall with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-split-view`, restart, and the window is back to normal. If the plugin itself breaks, boot stops with an error instead of a silent blank page, so uninstalling is also the emergency recovery path.

dsh-split-view README · Install：**Compatibility**: dsh `0.1.0-rc.6` through `0.2.x` — one build spans both host generations. dsh 0.2.0 added a peer-dependency gate, so on 0.2.5 or earlier the boot log shows `skipping profile bundle "dsh-split-view"` and no split buttons appear. Upgrade to 0.2.6 or later.

dsh-split-view README · Default shortcuts (customizable in Settings)：| Key (⌘ on macOS, Ctrl on Windows/Linux) | Action |
|---|---|
| ⇧⌘D | Split right |
| ⇧⌘V | Split down |
| ⇧⌘X | Close focused pane |
| ⇧⌘Enter | Maximize / restore focused pane |

dsh-split-view README · Settings：Open Settings from any pane; the navigation on the left has a "Split View" entry.

Four groups:

dsh-split-view README · Settings：- **Shortcuts**: click the combo of an action to start recording, press the new combo to rebind, Esc to cancel. What you bind is up to you: combos taken by the browser or the OS, or combos that collide with another action, still bind — you get a warning, not a block. The only hard rule is that a combo must include ⌘/Ctrl.
- **Focus highlight color**: the outline and title-bar tint of the focused pane. Preset palette, a custom color picker, plus "Follow theme" — follows the brand color token of the current skin, so it changes when you switch skins.
- **Title bar**: one switch hides all pane title bars. Note that the title bar carries the copy-session-info, split, maximize, reload and close buttons, and double-click-to-maximize and click-title-to-rename also live there — with it hidden, those actions are keyboard-only. Clicking a pane to focus it is unaffected.
- **Restore defaults**: resets everything above; asks for confirmation first.

dsh-split-view README · For other plugins：The whole split-view capability is exposed as a Cordis service: pane operations, pane×session operations (load a given session, send a message, rename, switch model, cancel a turn), plus queries and subscriptions. See [api.md](./api.md) for the service API aimed at integrators.
